{{Otheruses|Bantha}}
{{Quote|Have another round of bantha blasters, boys! Drink up while it's flowing!|Veeboo Lunx|<ref name="TOR:CV">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Confronting Veeboo|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Bantha blaster''' was a pink-and-green [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] drink which fizzed and popped. It was a party favorite at the palace of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], and was commonly served at the [[Hutt Chuba's]] restaurant and the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], [[Maggy the Gorgon's]].<ref name="The Phamtom Menace ½">[[Episode I: The Phantom Menace ½|''Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' ½]]</ref> Although a cantina favorite, it had a warning to drink with caution.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Bantha blaster}}</ref>
